aboutGame.title: What is Tales of Eternia Remastered?
paragraphs: Tales of Eternia Remastered is the 2026 enhanced edition of the classic 2001 JRPG, developed by TOSE Co., Ltd. and published by Bandai Namco Entertainment. It follows Reid Hershel, Farah Oersted, Keele Zeibel, and Meredy across two linked worlds — Inferia below and Celestia above — as they race to stop a disaster from consuming both.

Combat runs on the Aggressive Linear Motion Battle System, a real-time 2D system where you control one hero while three allies fight on their own. You chain normal attacks into artes, guard against telegraphed blows, and manage a shared TP pool. The remaster adds updated visuals, a rebuilt English script, a new English dub, and quality-of-life features such as an encounter rate toggle, objective icons, and a default run speed.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.description: Quick answers to the most common questions about Tales of Eternia Remastered.

items.question: What is Tales of Eternia Remastered?
items.answer: Tales of Eternia Remastered is the 2026 enhanced edition of the classic 2001 JRPG, developed by TOSE Co., Ltd. and published by Bandai Namco Entertainment. It follows Reid Hershel and his companions across the linked worlds of Inferia and Celestia, with updated visuals and modern quality-of-life features.

items.question: Which platforms is Tales of Eternia Remastered on?
items.answer: Tales of Eternia Remastered releases on PlayStation 4, PlayStation 5, Xbox Series X|S, Nintendo Switch, Nintendo Switch 2, and PC via Steam.

items.question: Is Tales of Eternia Remastered multiplayer?
items.answer: The official product page lists Tales of Eternia Remastered as single-player, with no co-op campaign, split-screen mode, or online matchmaking included.

items.question: How does combat work in Tales of Eternia Remastered?
items.answer: Battles run on the Aggressive Linear Motion Battle System (A.L.M.B.S.), a real-time 2D system. You control one hero while three allies act on their own, chaining normal attacks into artes, guarding against telegraphed attacks, and sharing a single TP pool for spells and artes.

items.question: How long is Tales of Eternia Remastered?
items.answer: Tales of Eternia Remastered is a full-length JRPG campaign — dozens of hours for the main story, with more if you chase optional Craymels, side quests, and skits across both worlds.

items.question: What is new in Tales of Eternia Remastered?
items.answer: The remaster adds updated visuals, a rebuilt English script, a new English dub, more than 250 skits, and quality-of-life features such as an encounter rate toggle, toggleable objective icons, and a default run speed.
